name: Screen Time
author: Bivek Nepal
description: macOS-style screen time: per-app usage today, a 24-hour timeline, and a weekly view, tracked locally.

barWidget.description: Per-app usage, 24-hour timeline, and weekly overview.

schema.label: Timeline slot length (minutes)
schema.description: Width of each segment in the 24-hour bar. 30 = 48 slots per day.

schema.label: Idle threshold (seconds)
schema.description: Stop counting once the user has been idle this long.

schema.label: Excluded apps
schema.description: App IDs (window classes) to ignore, e.g. ["steam", "discord"]
